fullContentHtml:
BPSC 72nd CCE 2026 Exam Postpoend – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the exam postponed notice for the post of 72nd Combined Competitive Examination Preliminary Examination 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 1187 posts. The online application process for BPSC 72nd Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 May 2026, to 31 May 2026. The Pre Exam is going to conducted on 25 October 2026 postponed. Candidates must Check their BPSC 72nd Pre Exam Postponed 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 May 2026
  • Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 26 July 2026 (Postponed)
  • New Exam Date : 25 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Exam Date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
